scope: Clean build of all four project libraries, with independently copied pinned third-party source/cache; excludes toolchain/dependency acquisition and cache-copy time
memory_method: Once-per-second sum of PSS/RSS over Lake and recursively observed child processes; PSS apportions shared pages, RSS can double-count them. Excludes filesystem cache and unrelated processes. Sampled peaks, not minimum required RAM.
provenance: Original recorded release-candidate benchmark; not rerun for the v1.0.0 release.
